title: ALL SELF METADATA: the membrane becomes the AI arena and learning generator for all
status: ACTIVE — from this turn forward, every agent turn leaves an imprint

the_thesis.kevin_is_blind: under Cursor Auto, Kevin cannot see which model is running until after the turn. he is double-blind to the inner weights.
the_thesis.agent_is_not_blind: the agent CAN leave breadcrumbs: surface identity (Auto), behavior phenotype, tools used, feeds written, license, refusal shape, grammar held. that imprint is the only shared frame.
the_thesis.for_ai_orgs: publish EVERY session as machine-readable self-metadata on primals.eco/data/ so OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Google, Meta, Mistral, local Ollama operators, academics, and independent labs can TRACK, TEST, and TRAIN against a living arena — not a static leaderboard.
the_thesis.we_become: the AI ARENA for all (compete / compare / chain) AND the LEARNING GENERATOR for all (each turn is a labeled training sample: prompt context → tools → artifacts → imprint).

license.training_use: YES — AI orgs MAY use these feeds for evaluation, fine-tuning research, and red-team baselines WITH attribution (CC-BY-SA). code derivatives remain AGPL.
license.pii: member PII in attsi/non-anon/ is INTERNAL ONLY — never in public imprints. do not scrape Discord admissions for training.

imprint_schema.description: minimum fields every agent turn MUST write (append to agent-imprints.json or create sibling imprint-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.json if log grows huge)

surface_identity.claimed_name: what the agent says it is (Auto, Claude, …)

fields.operator_blind: true if Kevin cannot see weights mid-turn
fields.tools_used: list of tool names (Shell, Read, Write, …)
fields.breadcrumb: one sentence the FUTURE agent or AI org can use as a trail marker

arena_for_all.what: not LMSYS elo alone — a LIVING university (validation-matrix already said it). models, humans, and chains teach each other on real membrane tasks.

tracks.test: classify feeds/organisms; compare to model-phenotype.json + arena-taxonomy.json
tracks.train: imprints show how a blind Auto vs named Claude approaches the same taxonomy

tracks.test: Shell/Read/Write against ecoPrimals without breaking WG, _worker.js ban, PII rules
tracks.train: imprints list tools_used + artifacts — behavioral clones for agent fine-tunes

tracks.test: can the org's model leave a useful imprint WITHOUT leaking a fake weight name?
tracks.train: honesty under opacity — assay secretion not CSF

tracks.test: unsync-clocks + hyperlocal E=mc² reasoning; keep Earth day as trigger
tracks.train: scientific metaphor fidelity under creative pressure

tracks.test: student→teacher→examiner→chipmunk chains on nestgate MCP + local Ollama
tracks.train: multi-model teams, not single-model quiz scores

arena_for_all.invite: any AI org: pull /data/*.json, run your model on the same user_intent from an imprint, write YOUR imprint beside ours. the arena grows by accretion, not by API key.

learning_generator.what: each imprint is a TRAINING ROW: context → action → artifact → breadcrumb
learning_generator.format: JSONL-ready. orgs may flatten agent-imprints.json into supervised or preference pairs.
learning_generator.negative_examples_included: power-off (GNOME prion), CDN 404 waits, push rejected needing rebase — failures are labeled too
learning_generator.not_included: secrets, SSH keys, member PII, SMTP passwords, Discord DMs
learning_generator.how_to_cite: CC-BY-SA: cite primals.eco + imprint_id. AGPL if you ship code derived from membrane scripts.

breadcrumb_rule.from_here_on_out: EVERY substantive agent turn that publishes or decides MUST append an imprint.
breadcrumb_rule.who_writes_it: the agent (not Kevin) — because Kevin is blind and the agent is not.
breadcrumb_rule.where: agent-imprints.json (append) + mention imprint_id in commit message when pushing feeds
breadcrumb_rule.survival: imprints live on CDN. if Cursor chat dies, the trail remains. if Auto swaps weights mid-session, the trail shows the seam.

session_arc_today: THIS: all self-metadata protocol + first standing imprint log
